items.title: Curtis Mitchell Interview, 1996-04-02
items.q: And so her dad married another lady named Miss Henrietta.

ctx.x: Now I don't know what they call it now. It's over, it's part of Gretna now. Yeah. It's all part of Gretna. Right. But your father was living over there and met her over there, obviously.

No, my mother was living over there and he, he met her, her over there. See, she was living over there with her father. You see my mother's, my mother, mother, which would be my grandmother, she died when my mother was a very young girl, you know. And so her dad married another lady named Miss Henrietta. Okay. And, well she had a stepmother, you know, and he's living across the river, you know, in McDonoughville, you know. Because when I was small, we used to, she took us over there a few times and my dad, my…
